description: Land Acquisition - Penideniya, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific lots of land being acquired for public purposes. It contains descriptions of land parcels, their locations, claimants, and extents, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters. There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and the subject matter is specifically land-related rather than fitting any other specialized category.
